newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian firms see Q4 profits higher - ABS.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian firms see Q4 profits higher - ABS.

text.p: Australian businesses expect profits to rise 3.7 percent in the December quarter from the previous quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
This compares with expectations that profits would rise 2.9 percent in the corresponding quarter last year.
The profit rise would come on the back of an expected 1.6 percent lift in sales and a 2.6 percent increase in capital expenditure during the December quarter.
Selling prices were seen 0.2 percent higher and employment was expected to grow 0.3 percent.
"This is the second consecutive quarterly increase in employment expectations," the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
The bureau's survey differs from other business expectations series in that it calculates the volume of expected movements as well as direction.
It does this by asking respondents for the size of expected movements and then weighting the results for the respondent's size.
Each survey, conducted in the middle month of each quarter, asks for expectations for the following quarter.
